string.value: Select all additional Language Packages that the users will interact with in the product.
Press []Tab], []Up], or []Down] to highlight, []Space] or []X] to toggle state, []Ctrl-B] to go back, []Ctrl-X] to quit, or []Enter] to continue.
Property SelectedLanguagePacks '[SelectedLanguagePacks]' must include the system locale.
Property SelectedLanguagePacks '[SelectedLanguagePacks]' must be a subset of the available language packs.
